title: Experimental ftir and raman spectra of dimers of transiently chiral alcohols and (a)chiral hydroxy esters in the range of 3700 and 3300 cm-1

notes: We provide experimental FTIR and Raman spectra of supersonic jet expansions for four systems (all in the range of 3700 and 3300 cm-1): benzyl alcohol + methyl (S)-(-)-lactate, benzyl alcohol + methyl glycolate, 4-chlorobenzyl alcohol + methyl (S)-(-)-lactate, 4-chlorobenzyl alcohol + methyl glycolate. Nomenclature for FTIR spectra: volatile compound_saturator temperature(in °C, "m" stands for "minus")_low volatile compound_temperature_nozzle temperature_number of pulses. Nomenclature for Raman spectra: volatile compound_temperature of coolable saturator_low volatile compound_temperature of heatable saturator_backing pressure_nozzle temperature_monochromator wavelength_distance nozzle-laser_laser power_number of exposures x time of single exposure The spectra are provided as data point tables (FTIR) / in the ASCII format (Raman). Columns are separated by commas (FTIR) / tabulators (Raman). The first column corresponds to the wavenumber in cm−1 and the second to the absorbance (FTIR) / intensity in arbitrary units(Raman).
